topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: sumOf
description: Returns the total using long arithmetic; returns 0 for a null or empty array.
code_b: public static long sumOf(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } long sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { sum += values[i]; } return sum; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: averageOf
description: Returns the arithmetic mean; returns 0.0 for a null or empty array. The calculation uses Java double arithmetic.
code_b: public static double averageOf(double[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0.0; } double sum = 0.0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { sum += values[i]; } return sum / values.length; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: countNegative
description: Returns the number of negative elements; returns 0 for a null or empty array.
code_b: public static int countNegative(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] < 0) { count++; } } return count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: countInRange
signature: public static int countInRange(double[] values, double lower, double upper)
description: Counts elements between lower and upper, inclusive; returns 0 for a null or empty array or when lower is greater than upper. NaN elements and NaN bounds are not counted because the comparisons are false.
code_b: public static int countInRange(double[] values, double lower, double upper) { if (values == null || values.length == 0 || lower > upper) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] >= lower && values[i] <= upper) { count++; } } return count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: sumBeforeFirstNegative
description: Returns the sum of elements before the first negative element; returns 0 for a null or empty array or if the first element is negative. The sum uses long arithmetic.
code_b: public static long sumBeforeFirstNegative(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } long sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] < 0) { break; } sum += values[i]; } return sum; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: countZeros
description: Returns the number of elements equal to zero; returns 0 for a null or empty array. Both positive and negative zero count as zero; NaN does not.
code_b: public static int countZeros(double[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] == 0.0) { count++; } } return count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: countNonNegative
description: Returns the number of elements that are positive or zero; returns 0 for a null or empty array. NaN is not counted.
code_b: public static int countNonNegative(double[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] >= 0.0) { count++; } } return count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: sumMatrix
description: Returns the sum of all elements, using long arithmetic; returns 0 for a null or empty matrix and ignores null rows. An empty row contributes nothing.
code_b: public static long sumMatrix(int[][] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } long sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] != null) { for (int j = 0; j < values[i].length; j++) { sum += values[i][j]; } } } return sum; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: sumPositive
description: Returns the sum of values greater than zero; null and empty arrays return 0.0. NaN values are not included because they are not greater than zero.
code_b: public static double sumPositive(double[] values) { if (values == null) return 0.0; double sum = 0.0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] > 0.0) sum += values[i]; } return sum; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: countEven
description: Returns the number of even integers in the array. Null and empty arrays return 0.
code_b: public static int countEven(int[] values) { if (values == null) return 0; int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] % 2 == 0) count++; } return count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: averagePositive
description: Returns the average of values greater than zero; null and empty arrays return 0.0. It also returns 0.0 when the array has no positive values.
code_b: public static double averagePositive(double[] values) { if (values == null) return 0.0; double sum = 0.0; int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] > 0.0) { sum += values[i]; count++; } } if (count == 0) return 0.0; return sum / count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: cumulativeSums
description: Returns an array where each position contains the running total through that position in the input. Null and empty arrays return an empty array.
code_b: public static int[] cumulativeSums(int[] values) { if (values == null) return new int[0]; int[] sums = new int[values.length]; int total = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { total += values[i]; sums[i] = total; } return sums; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: countTrue
description: Returns the number of true values in the array. Null and empty arrays return 0.
code_b: public static int countTrue(boolean[] values) { if (values == null) return 0; int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i]) count++; } return count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: sumAtEvenIndexes
description: Returns the sum of values at indexes 0, 2, 4, and so on. Null and empty arrays return 0.
code_b: public static int sumAtEvenIndexes(int[] values) { if (values == null) return 0; int sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i += 2) { sum += values[i]; } return sum; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: rowSums
description: Returns an array containing the sum of each row. A null matrix returns an empty array, and a null row contributes 0.
code_b: public static int[] rowSums(int[][] values) { if (values == null) return new int[0]; int[] sums = new int[values.length]; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] != null) { for (int j = 0; j < values[i].length; j++) { sums[i] += values[i][j]; } } } return sums; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: adjacentRelationCounts
description: Returns three counts in order: increasing adjacent pairs, equal adjacent pairs, and decreasing adjacent pairs. Null arrays and arrays with fewer than two elements return {0, 0, 0}.
code_b: public static int[] adjacentRelationCounts(int[] values) { int[] counts = new int[3]; if (values == null || values.length < 2) return counts; for (int i = 0; i < values.length - 1; i++) { if (values[i] < values[i + 1]) counts[0]++; else if (values[i] == values[i + 1]) counts[1]++; else counts[2]++; } return counts; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: countOccurrences
signature: public static int countOccurrences(int[] values, int target)
description: Returns the number of elements equal to target. A null or empty array returns 0.
code_b: public static int countOccurrences(int[] values, int target) { int count = 0; if (values == null) { return 0; } for (int value : values) { if (value == target) { count++; } } return count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: sumOddIndexedValues
description: Returns the sum of elements at odd indexes (1, 3, 5, and so on). A null or empty array returns 0.
code_b: public static long sumOddIndexedValues(int[] values) { long sum = 0; if (values == null) { return 0; } for (int i = 1; i < values.length; i += 2) { sum += values[i]; } return sum; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: averageEvenValues
description: Returns the average of the even-valued elements. A null array or an array with no even values returns 0.0.
code_b: public static double averageEvenValues(int[] values) { if (values == null) { return 0.0; } long sum = 0; int count = 0; for (int value : values) { if (value % 2 == 0) { sum += value; count++; } } if (count == 0) { return 0.0; } return (double) sum / count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: countUntilStop
signature: public static int countUntilStop(char[] values, char stop, char target)
description: Counts target characters before the first stop character; the stop character itself is not counted. A null or empty array returns 0, and if stop equals target, the count is 0.
code_b: public static int countUntilStop(char[] values, char stop, char target) { if (values == null || stop == target) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (char value : values) { if (value == stop) { break; } if (value == target) { count++; } } return count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: countStartingWith
signature: public static int countStartingWith(String[] words, String prefix)
description: Counts non-null strings that start with prefix. A null array or null prefix returns 0; an empty array returns 0, and an empty prefix matches every non-null string.
code_b: public static int countStartingWith(String[] words, String prefix) { if (words == null || prefix == null) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (String word : words) { if (word != null && word.startsWith(prefix)) { count++; } } return count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: averageNonNullStringLength
description: Returns the average length of the non-null strings; empty strings are included with length 0. A null or empty array, or an array containing only nulls, returns 0.0.
code_b: public static double averageNonNullStringLength(String[] words) { if (words == null) { return 0.0; } long totalLength = 0; int count = 0; for (String word : words) { if (word != null) { totalLength += word.length(); count++; } } if (count == 0) { return 0.0; } return (double) totalLength / count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: countRowDivisibleValues
description: Counts elements in each row that are divisible by that row's one-based number (row 0 uses divisor 1). A null matrix, empty matrix, or null or empty row contributes nothing.
code_b: public static int countRowDivisibleValues(int[][] values) { if (values == null) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] != null) { for (int value : values[i]) { if (value % (i + 1) == 0) { count++; } } } } return count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: countAtOrBelowPreviousAverage
description: Counts elements, starting at index 1, that are at or below the average of all earlier elements. A null or empty array returns 0; an array with one element also returns 0.
code_b: public static int countAtOrBelowPreviousAverage(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length < 2) { return 0; } long sum = values[0]; int count = 0; for (int i = 1; i < values.length; i++) { double average = (double) sum / i; if (values[i] <= average) { count++; } sum += values[i]; } return count; }

topic: running totals, averages and counts over int or double arrays
name: sumEveryThirdValue

topic: finding the largest or smallest value, or its position, in an array (values may be negative)
name: secondLargestDistinct
description: Returns the second-largest distinct value, or null if the array is null, empty, or has fewer than two distinct values. Negative values are handled normally.
code_b: public static Integer secondLargestDistinct(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return null; } int largest = 0; int secondLargest = 0; boolean hasLargest = false; boolean hasSecondLargest = false; for (int value : values) { if (!hasLargest || value > largest) { if (hasLargest) { secondLargest = largest; hasSecondLargest = true; } largest = value; hasLargest = true; } else if (value < largest && (!hasSecondLargest || value > secondLargest)) { secondLargest = value; hasSecondLargest = true; } } return hasSecondLargest ? secondLargest : null; }

topic: finding the largest or smallest value, or its position, in an array (values may be negative)
name: rowWithLargestSum
description: Returns the index of the row with the largest sum, keeping the first row in a tie. Null rows are ignored, empty rows count as sum zero, and -1 is returned for a null matrix or one with no non-null rows.
code_b: public static int rowWithLargestSum(int[][] matrix) { if (matrix == null) { return -1; } int bestRow = -1; int largestSum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < matrix.length; i++) { if (matrix[i] != null) { int sum = 0; for (int value : matrix[i]) { sum += value; } if (bestRow == -1 || sum > largestSum) { largestSum = sum; bestRow = i; } } } return bestRow; }

topic: finding the largest or smallest value, or its position, in an array (values may be negative)
name: smallestCharacter
description: Returns the smallest character in the array. Returns '\u0000' for a null or empty array; that character may also be a valid array value.
code_b: public static char smallestCharacter(char[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return (char) 0; } char smallest = values[0]; for (int i = 1; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] < smallest) { smallest = values[i]; } } return smallest; }

topic: finding the largest or smallest value, or its position, in an array (values may be negative)
name: smallestNonNullString

code_b: public static String smallestNonNullString(String[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return null; } String smallest = null; for (String value : values) { if (value != null && (smallest == null || value.compareTo(smallest) < 0)) { smallest = value; } } return smallest; }

topic: finding the largest or smallest value, or its position, in an array (values may be negative)
name: largestEven
description: Returns the largest even value, or null for a null or empty array or an array with no even values. Negative even values are included.
code_b: public static Integer largestEven(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return null; } Integer largest = null; for (int value : values) { if (value % 2 == 0 && (largest == null || value > largest)) { largest = value; } } return largest; }

topic: finding the largest or smallest value, or its position, in an array (values may be negative)
name: smallestPositive
description: Returns the smallest positive value, or null for a null or empty list or when there is no positive value. Null list elements are ignored.
code_b: public static Integer smallestPositive(List<Integer> values) { if (values == null || values.isEmpty()) { return null; } Integer smallest = null; for (Integer value : values) { if (value != null && value > 0 && (smallest == null || value < smallest)) { smallest = value; } } return smallest; }

topic: finding the largest or smallest value, or its position, in an array (values may be negative)
name: columnMaxima
description: Returns an array containing the maximum value in each column; rows shorter than a column are skipped, and ties do not affect the result. A null matrix, an empty matrix, or a matrix with only null or empty rows returns an empty array; null rows are ignored.
code_b: public static int[] columnMaxima(int[][] matrix) { if (matrix == null || matrix.length == 0) { return new int[0]; } int columnCount = 0; for (int[] row : matrix) { if (row != null && row.length > columnCount) { columnCount = row.length; } } int[] maxima = new int[columnCount]; boolean[] hasValue = new boolean[columnCount]; for (int[] row : matrix) { if (row != null) { for (int column = 0; column < row.length; column++) { if (!hasValue[column] || row[column] > maxima[column]) { maxima[column] = row[column]; hasValue[column] = true; } } } } return maxima; }

topic: finding the largest or smallest value, or its position, in an array (values may be negative)
name: largestBeforeFirstNegative
description: Returns the largest value before the first negative value, stopping the scan at that negative value. Returns null for a null or empty array, or if the first value is negative; zero and other nonnegative values are included.
code_b: public static Integer largestBeforeFirstNegative(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return null; } Integer largest = null; for (int value : values) { if (value < 0) { break; } if (largest == null || value > largest) { largest = value; } } return largest; }

topic: finding the largest or smallest value, or its position, in an array (values may be negative)

name: largestAdjacentRise

topic: finding the largest or smallest value, or its position, in an array (values may be negative)

topic: finding the largest or smallest value, or its position, in an array (values may be negative)
name: smallestAtOddIndices

topic: finding the largest or smallest value, or its position, in an array (values may be negative)

description: Returns the smallest value other than NaN; positive and negative infinity are included. Returns Double.NaN if values is null, empty, or contains only NaN values.

topic: finding the largest or smallest value, or its position, in an array (values may be negative)

code_b: public static int smallestValueWithOddFrequency(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) return 0; boolean found = false; int smallest = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { boolean seenBefore = false; for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) { if (values[j] == values[i]) seenBefore = true; } if (!seenBefore) { int count = 0; for (int j = 0; j < values.length; j++) { if (values[j] == values[i]) count++; } if (count % 2 == 1 && (!found || values[i] < smallest)) { smallest = values[i]; found = true; } } } return found ? smallest : 0; }

name: classifyPositiveCount

code_b: public static int classifyPositiveCount(int[] values) { if (values == null) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length && count < 7; i++) { if (values[i] > 0) { count++; } } if (count == 0) { return 0; } if (count <= 3) { return 1; } if (count <= 6) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyLargestMagnitude
description: Returns -1 for a null or empty array. Otherwise, finds the largest absolute value and returns 0 for 0–9, 1 for 10–99, 2 for 100–999, and 3 for 1000 or more; the calculation safely handles Integer.MIN_VALUE.
code_b: public static int classifyLargestMagnitude(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return -1; } long largest = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { long magnitude = Math.abs((long) values[i]); if (magnitude > largest) { largest = magnitude; } } if (largest <= 9) { return 0; } if (largest <= 99) { return 1; } if (largest <= 999) { return 2; } return 3; }

name: classifyVowelCount

code_b: public static int classifyVowelCount(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) { char letter = Character.toLowerCase(text.charAt(i)); if (letter == 'a' || letter == 'e' || letter == 'i' || letter == 'o' || letter == 'u') { count++; } } if (count == 0) { return 0; } if (count <= 2) { return 1; } if (count <= 5) { return 2; } return 3; }

code_b: public static int classifyMatrixCellCount(int[][] matrix) { if (matrix == null) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < matrix.length; i++) { if (matrix[i] != null) { for (int j = 0; j < matrix[i].length; j++) { count++; if (count > 20) { return 3; } } } } if (count == 0) { return 0; } if (count <= 5) { return 1; } return 2; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups

code_b: public static int classifyLongestHotStreak(int[] dailyTemperatures) { if (dailyTemperatures == null || dailyTemperatures.length == 0) { return 0; } int longest = 0; int current = 0; for (int i = 0; i < dailyTemperatures.length; i++) { if (dailyTemperatures[i] >= 30) { current++; if (current > longest) { longest = current; } } else { current = 0; } } if (longest == 0) { return 0; } if (longest <= 2) { return 1; } if (longest <= 5) { return 2; } return 3; }

code_b: public static int classifyAverageMonthlyRainfall(double[] rainfall) { if (rainfall == null || rainfall.length == 0) { return 0; } double total = 0.0; for (int i = 0; i < rainfall.length; i++) { if (Double.isNaN(rainfall[i]) || rainfall[i] < 0.0) { return -1; } total += rainfall[i]; } double average = total / rainfall.length; if (average < 10.0) { return 0; } if (average < 50.0) { return 1; } if (average < 100.0) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyMatchingNeighborPairs
description: Counts equal horizontally or vertically adjacent pairs, then returns 0 for none, 1 for 1–3 pairs, 2 for 4–10 pairs, and 3 for more than 10 pairs. Returns 0 for a null or empty grid; null rows are treated as empty.
code_b: public static int classifyMatchingNeighborPairs(int[][] grid) { if (grid == null || grid.length == 0) { return 0; } int pairs = 0; for (int row = 0; row < grid.length; row++) { if (grid[row] != null) { for (int column = 0; column < grid[row].length - 1; column++) { if (grid[row][column] == grid[row][column + 1]) { pairs++; if (pairs > 10) { return 3; } } } } } for (int row = 0; row < grid.length - 1; row++) { int[] current = grid[row]; int[] next = grid[row + 1]; if (current != null && next != null) { int limit = Math.min(current.length, next.length); for (int column = 0; column < limit; column++) { if (current[column] == next[column]) { pairs++; if (pairs > 10) { return 3; } } } } } if (pairs == 0) { return 0; } if (pairs <= 3) { return 1; } if (pairs <= 10) { return 2; } return 3; }

name: classifyArrayRange

code_b: public static String classifyArrayRange(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) return "empty"; int min = values[0]; int max = values[0]; for (int value : values) { if (value < min) min = value; if (value > max) max = value; } long range = (long) max - min; if (range <= 10) return "narrow"; if (range <= 100) return "moderate"; if (range <= 1000) return "wide"; return "very wide"; }

code_b: public static String classifyUppercaseShare(char[] characters) { if (characters == null || characters.length == 0) return "empty"; long letters = 0; long uppercase = 0; for (char character : characters) { if ((character >= 'A' && character <= 'Z') || (character >= 'a' && character <= 'z')) { letters++; if (character >= 'A' && character <= 'Z') uppercase++; } } if (letters == 0) return "no letters"; if (uppercase * 4 <= letters) return "low"; if (uppercase * 4 <= letters * 3) return "mixed"; return "mostly uppercase"; }
